Influence of the gut microbiota on neuropsychiatric disorders.  Alterations in the gut microbiota contribute to depression through mechanisms involving inflammation and the kynurenine pathway. Dysbiosis influences the availability of tryptophan for serotonin synthesis and impacts SCFA levels, which are linked to mood regulation and depressive symptoms.
